rationale: The short thesis is not yet invalidated — price remains below VWAP ($33.74) and in the lower third of the day's range, the bounce off 33.30 is on fading volume (6.5k→4.3k per candle), and the latest bar closed back under the 9-EMA at 33.49, stalling just beneath the 33.55 shelf on a still risk-off tape.
